V0159_01_00_00_0.text: For everything I aspire to be, I must win!

V0159_01_00_01_0.text:
You wish to Duel me?
Very well!

V0159_01_00_02_0.text: Let's give it our all and leave nothing to chance!

V0159_01_00_03_0.text: I'm curious to find out what Deck you play.

V0159_01_00_04_0.text: There's only one Duelist that I want to face.

V0159_01_00_04_1.text:
Jaden!
I expect nothing but the best from you!

V0159_01_00_05_0.text: Our paths didn't cross at Duel Academy, but it does now.

V0159_03_00_00_0.text: Every move I make is perfect!

V0159_03_00_01_0.text: It's time to bring this Duel to an end.

V0159_03_00_04_0.text:
I see you're giving it your very best.
Then so will I!

V0159_03_00_05_0.text:
I'm impressed.
You're actually making this fun for me!

V0159_06_01_02_0.text: If that's what you're going to do...

V0159_06_01_03_0.text: I won't let you do that!

V0159_07_09_00_0.text: I flip over the card I Set!

V0159_11_01_00_0.text: I Summon a monster in Defense Position!

V0159_21_00_00_0.text:
Enough of your nonsense.
You're only embarrassing yourself.

V0159_21_00_01_0.text:
You can act tough.
But that doesn't mean you are tough.

V0159_21_00_04_0.text:
Don't worry about me.
I'm still fine!

V0159_28_00_00_0.text: Since you gave it your all, I responded in kind.

V0159_28_00_00_1.text: That's how I show my respect!

V0159_28_00_01_0.text: There's more to my Deck than just Cyber End Dragon.

V0159_28_00_02_0.text: Every move you made was more pointless than the last.

V0159_28_00_03_0.text:
Don't feel bad.
You lost to the best.

V0159_28_00_04_0.text: I was hoping for a more challenging Duel.

V0159_28_00_06_0.text: Your combo certainly had some bite.

V0159_28_00_06_1.text: But I did tell you that Cyber End Dragon is invincible!

V0159_28_00_07_0.text: Where's the Jaden that actually posed a challenge?

V0159_28_00_08_0.text: I knew you weren't ready to use that card yet.

V0159_29_00_00_0.text: Looks like someone has studied up on me.

V0159_29_00_01_0.text:
That was a good Duel...
I hope we meet again.

V0159_29_00_03_0.text: If I could've only Dueled my Duel...

V0159_29_00_05_0.text: You don't need to be perfect.

V0159_29_00_05_1.text: You just need to be you, Jaden!

V0159_29_00_06_0.text:
You proved me wrong, Syrus.
You do belong.

V0159_33_00_00_0.text: I'll show you the peak of perfection!

V0159_30_00_00_0.text:
You can have this card.
So pretend this Duel never happened.

V0159_30_00_01_0.text: You're not good enough to play that card!

V0159_30_00_02_0.text: I won't let you play that card until you're a real Duelist!

V0159_34_00_00_0.text: Heh... There's style to your strategy.

V0159_34_00_01_0.text: Whoever has this card has the advantage!

V0159_34_00_02_0.text: None of your monsters compare to Cyber End Dragon!

V0159_34_00_03_0.text: We both had the same idea. But my timing was better!

V0159_34_00_04_0.text: I regret choosing you as my opponent.

V0159_34_00_05_0.text: Stop overthinking it. Trust your instincts!

V0159_34_00_06_0.text: It's a shame that this is my final Duel at Duel Academy.

V0159_34_00_07_0.text: Your Dueling has earned my respect.

V0159_34_00_08_0.text: This pain I feel... This is no Duel! You lied to me!

V0159_34_00_09_0.text: Let me out of here! I don't want to be a part of this world!

V0159_34_00_10_0.text: No...No! I don't want to lose!

V0159_34_00_11_0.text: Respecting my opponents was a mistake.

V0159_34_00_12_0.text: I should have been focused on winning!

V0159_32_00_01_0.text:
Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links
Always show your opponent respect.

V0159_35_00_00_0.text:
I'm Zane Truesdale.
Who's worthy of me?

V0159_35_00_01_0.text: Every Duelist I face deserves my respect.

V0159_36_00_02_0.text:
It's not over!
It's never over!

V0159_36_00_03_0.text: Jaden, no one Duels the way that you Duel.

V0159_36_00_04_0.text: Show me what you can do, Syrus.
